tool_input.description: Check shared-block markers in restore.sh and report.sh

tool_input.command: t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir "$t/d"; for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do : > "$t/d/app-$s.tar.gz"; done; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/d" --name app --keep 1 --dry-run; ls "$t/d" | wc -l | tr -d ' '; rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Dry-run rotate with keep=1, verify nothing deleted

result:
All done — the suite passes end to end (11 checks, "all tests passed"). Details of what changed:

- **rotate.sh** — fixed the rotation math: `surplus()` now lists the oldest `total - keep` archives (`head -n "$((total - keep))"`, guarded for BSD `head` rejecting 0) instead of `tail -n +keep`, which kept the *oldest* N−1 and deleted the newest. Replaced the inline option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` with `source lib/common.sh`.
- **verify.sh** — the sidecar file name is now parsed as everything after the digest (`${line#*"$expected"}` with leading whitespace stripped) instead of `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated names at the first space; also quoted the digest comparison. Same shared-library source swap.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — the shared option parser (fills `DEST/NAME/KEEP/QUIET/DRY_RUN/ARGS`), `is_uint`, `need_value`, `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`, with a double-sourcing guard in the same style as `lib/log.sh`. Sourcing it runs the parser against the caller's positional parameters, so both scripts accept the exact same flags as before (verified `--help`, `-q`, `-n/--dry-run`, `--dest/--name/--keep`, unknown-option and `--keep` validation).
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — added a verify test (space in archive name → `ok`, rc=0) and a rotate group (exactly `--keep 5` deletes nothing; `--keep 3` removes the two oldest with their sidecars and keeps the newest three).

Note: a scratch verification script remains at `/tmp/rotate_dryrun_check.sh` — removing it needs a permission approval, so I left it; `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` were left untouched as requested.

Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh`.
